## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A four-fascicle structural-outline (*kē* 科) of **Dàoxuān**'s ([道宣](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%81%93%E5%AE%A3)) *Sìfēnlǜ shānbǔ suíjī jiémó shū* 四分律刪補隨機羯磨疏 ([KR6k0019](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0019)) by **Yuánzhào** 元照 ([元照](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%85%83%E7%85%A7), 1048–1116), the Northern Sòng *Língzhīsì* 靈芝寺 Vinaya-school revivalist. Author signature: *餘杭郡沙門釋　元照　錄* (*Recorded by Yuánzhào, monk of Yúháng commandery*). The *kē* serves as the structural index for Yuánzhào's own *Jìyuán jì* 濟緣記 ([KR6k0158](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0158)) on the same parent text.

**Abstract**

The *Kē* is the structural counterpart to Yuánzhào's substantive sub-commentary [KR6k0158](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0158) *Sìfēnlǜ shānbǔ suíjī jiémó shū jìyuán jì* and is studied alongside it in the Sòng *Nánshānlǜ* curriculum. Yuánzhào's *kē* is more granular than Yǔn Kān's earlier *Zhèngyuán jì* ([KR6k0156](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0156)), reflecting the late-eleventh-century maturation of the *Lǜzōng* sub-commentary tradition. Composition belongs to Yuánzhào's mature Vinaya output (post-1075).
